note: NOT AN ARTICLE — an Anubis bot check, which is what hal.science answered a plain GET for https://hal.science/hal-05779468 with on 2026-10-06 (the paper's PDF address answers with the same page). It is the long wall 260904e § C1 was waiting for: 1,034 characters of it read as article text, twice the capability floor, so stage 2 published it as an article titled 'Making sure you're not a bot!' until src/challenge-page.ts recognised the page's own <script id="anubis_challenge"> element. ONE EDIT TO THE BYTES: Anubis echoes the caller's IP address into that element's JSON as X-Real-Ip, and the value was replaced with 192.0.2.1 (a documentation address) before commit. The challenge is minted per request, so verify.mts --refetch will always report this page as changed. docs/plans/261006c-a-bot-check-page-is-refused-by-its-own-markup.md.
